scripts.build:packages: yarn workspace @district/contracts build && yarn workspace @district/domain build && yarn workspace @district/application build && yarn workspace @district/persistence build && yarn workspace @district/integrations build
scripts.build: yarn build:packages && yarn workspace @district/worker build && yarn workspace @district/web build
scripts.typecheck: yarn build:packages && yarn workspaces foreach -A --exclude district-workflow run typecheck
scripts.test: yarn build:packages && yarn workspace @district/persistence test && yarn workspace @district/worker test
scripts.db:test:docker:up: docker compose -f infrastructure/compose.yaml --profile test up -d --wait postgres-test
scripts.db:test:docker:down: docker compose -f infrastructure/compose.yaml --profile test stop postgres-test
